protocol: Three interleaved fresh-browser pairs per fixture; default browser heap policy

baseline.metric: Input-handler entry to second animation-frame callback; not compositor-present latency
baseline.aggregation: Median of three within-trial medians. P95 is the median of within-trial nearest-rank p95 values.

optimized.metric: Input-handler entry to second animation-frame callback; not compositor-present latency
optimized.aggregation: Median of three within-trial medians. P95 is the median of within-trial nearest-rank p95 values.
